name: SBIntuitions-SearchBot
description: SB Intuitions' user-triggered fetcher. The operator documents that when someone asks its Sarashina service a question, this agent visits websites on that person's behalf to improve the quality of the search results it reasons over, that answers may include links to the pages it visited, and that what it retrieves is not used for AI development. That last point distinguishes it from SBIntuitionsBot, which the same page says is used for AI development and information analysis.
